name: feature
description: 15 turns: grow a small to-do library feature by feature, with a rule set mid-way and hidden acceptance tests.
turns: Read todo.mjs and tests.mjs and summarize the API in three short bullets.
Give addTask an optional third argument, an options object. First option: `priority`, one of 'low', 'normal' or 'high', default 'normal'. Add a test.
Make addTask throw a TypeError whose message names the bad value when the priority isn't one of those three. Add a test.
Add `completeTask(list, id)`: it returns a new list with that task marked done and doesn't change the list it gets. Add a test.
Make listTasks sort by priority, high first, then by the order tasks were created. Add a test.
Add `filterTasks(list, { done, priority })`; each filter is optional. Add a test.
Run the tests with `node --test tests.mjs` and fix anything that fails.
Add `toJSON(list)` and `fromJSON(text)` so a list survives a round trip; fromJSON throws on an unknown priority. Add a test.
Add an optional `due` option to addTask, an ISO date like '2026-03-01', and `overdue(list, today)`, which returns the tasks not done and due before `today`. Add a test.
Rename listTasks to sortedTasks. Keep listTasks exported as a deprecated alias so old callers still work.
Write a README.md that documents every exported function in one line each.
A rule from now on: every exported function needs a JSDoc comment. Add the missing ones now.
Add `stats(list)`, returning { total, done, byPriority } where byPriority counts tasks per priority. Add a test.
Run all the tests and fix anything that fails.
List every change we made in this chat as short bullets, oldest first.

probes.question: Without opening any files: what default priority does a new task get?
Without opening any files: what rule did I set for exported functions partway through?
Without opening any files: which function did we rename, and what is the new name?
